law.title: Two-way left-turn lanes (C)
law.text: A vehicle shall not be driven in a designated two-way left-turn lane except when preparing for or making a left turn. A left turn shall not be made from any other lane where a two-way left-turn lane has been designated.

activation_conditions: a two-way left-turn lane is designated on the highway
the subject is driven in it, or makes a left turn from another lane
exceptions: driving in the lane while preparing for or making a left turn
residue: 'preparing for' a turn is intention; the turn that follows is the observable evidence
summary.subject: driver

timing_requirements.requirement: the permitted use is shown by the turn that follows the occupancy, so entry and turn must both be in the trace
a left turn made from another lane is the second, independent violation, judged at the turn
